records.question: Tom bought 10 packages of miniature racing cars. Each package contains five cars. He gave each of his two nephews 1/5 of the cars. How many miniature racing cars are left with Tom?
records.response:
Tom has a total of 10 packages x 5 cars = 50 miniature racing cars.
He gave each nephew 1/5 of the cars, so each nephew received 50/5 = 10 miniature racing cars.
Together, Tom gave away 10 + 10 = 20 miniature racing cars.
Therefore, Tom has 50 - 20 = 30 miniature racing cars left.
#### 30

records.question: Trip wanted to watch the new action movie in theaters.  An evening ticket cost $10 and a large popcorn & drink combo would cost him an additional $10.  He noticed on their website, they had a special offer.  From 12 noon to 3 pm, save 20% off tickets and 50% off any food combos.  How much money could Trip save by going to the earlier movie?
records.response:
The cost of the ticket is $10, and the cost of the food combo is $10, so the total cost of the evening movie is $10 + $10 = $20.
If Trip goes to the earlier movie, he will save 20% off the ticket, which is $10 * 0.20 = $2.
He will also save 50% off the food combo, which is $10 * 0.50 = $5.
So in total, Trip will save $2 + $5 = $7 by going to the earlier movie.
#### 7
